gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Noto Sans Bamum keeps its letters wide open and gently curved. Groovy, with its nearly sealed c and loosely spaced lowercase, gives way to a body that would move unhurried through paragraph after paragraph.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Sturdy, big-middled lowercase with a gaping c gives the body text its steady presence. Noto Sans Bassa Vah carries long paragraphs, while Groovy's round bowls keep their walls uniform, never swelling or tapering.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-batak: Noto Sans Batak stands tall in the lowercase and leaves its e wide open, so nothing ever looks squeezed. Groovy's constant-line, blueprint feel earns its keep when big and brief.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Groovy is loose and friendly, its c nearly pinched shut. Noto Sans Bengali opens every mouth wide and keeps capitals barely above lowercase, so paragraphs run along smoothly in the body.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Tight-coiled lowercase with open apertures makes Noto Sans Bhaiksuki read friendly and clear. Groovy, bent like a single length of wire, leads from the top while the body carries the words below.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Curves that stay open-ended and a high mean line give the body text a light, modern look. Noto Sans Brahmi sits quietly under Groovy, whose nearly shut c and loose spacing do the talking.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Groovy gives its tails and terminals the full weight of the stems, for a friendly, funky look. And Noto Sans Buginese does the quieter job, with open chalk-arc mouths and short ascenders that keep lines compact.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid leaves generous gaps where curves meet stems. Groovy does its best work loud and showy, with a nearly closed c, while the body font settles into running text with its high x-height.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-carian: Clean, Noto Sans Carian keeps terminals apart like open scissor blades. Beside Groovy's snug slit of a c, long paragraphs would glide, helped by tiny gaps under the ascender tops.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Noto Sans Chakma reads openly, its lowercase packed up toward the capitals and its s and c uncrowded. But the best thing about the pairing is how Groovy's nearly closed c sets off those open mouths.
